cases.name: startup: AES loaded from the boot folder, menu bar and desktop icons
clicking icons selects and deselects them
double-clicking the boot drive opens its listing window
arrows scroll, clicks and cursor keys select rows
File:Close (Ctrl-W) closes the window and frees its listing
Desk:About shows an alert and restores the desktop exactly
Options:Launcher replaces the desktop with the card launcher
double-clicking a listed file hands it to the dispatcher (device 8)
a drive window lists its directory sorted by name
View sorts by type, size (largest first), directory order and name; the item is checked
Show Info (Ctrl-I) opens a dialog for the selected entry; Esc restores the window exactly
the Drive 9 icon opens a second, staggered window over the first
Show Info on a drive icon counts its files and blocks
a click in the slider track pages down (clamped to the last page)
dragging the thumb to the top of the track scrolls to the first entry
clicking the lower window tops it
a drive that cannot be read gives an error alert and opens nothing
four folder windows open at once; a fifth is refused with an alert
Show Info shows a locked file as read-only (a disabled, checked box)
Show Info renames: the edited name is sent as R0:NEW=OLD and the drive is listed again
renaming onto an existing name shows the drive's refusal and changes nothing
Ctrl-D asks first (Cancel is the default), then scratches the file and lists the drive again
a file dropped on Trash is confirmed; a locked file the drive skips is reported, not hidden
dragging a row onto Trash deletes it after confirmation
names with DOS pattern characters, a busy command channel and a failed OPEN are refused with alerts
Preferences: a checkbox, a radio group, Tab and cursor focus; clicking Cancel changes nothing, OK applies the sort order
with Confirm deletes off, Ctrl-D deletes at once
